name: Bench press
steps: Eyes under the bar. Squeeze shoulder blades together and down, feet planted.
Grip so forearms are vertical at the bottom.
Lower under control to the lower chest, touch, press up and slightly back.
Brace and hold your breath for each rep. Glutes stay on the bench.
mistakes: Bouncing the bar off the chest

name: Incline bench
steps: Set the bench at 30 degrees and plant your feet.
Lower the bar to the upper chest with elbows about 45 degrees from the torso.
Press up until your arms are straight over the shoulders.
mistakes: Bench set too steep, turning it into a shoulder press
Lifting the head off the bench

name: Dumbbell bench press
steps: Sit with dumbbells on your thighs, then lie back and kick them up.
Lower until the elbows are just below the bench, wrists over elbows.
Press up and slightly in, keeping shoulder blades pinned.
mistakes: Dropping too deep and straining the shoulders

name: Incline dumbbell press
steps: Set the bench at 30 degrees and start with dumbbells at chest height.
Press up until the arms are straight, palms facing forward.
Lower slowly to a deep stretch without losing tension.
mistakes: Banging the dumbbells together at the top

name: Machine chest press
steps: Set the seat so the handles line up with the middle of your chest.
Press forward until the arms are almost straight.
Return slowly until you feel a stretch across the chest.
mistakes: Seat set too low or too high
Locking the elbows hard at the top

name: Push-ups
steps: Hands just wider than the shoulders, body in one straight line.
Lower until the chest nearly touches the floor.
Press back up without letting the hips sag.
mistakes: Half reps with the head dropping first

name: Cable fly
steps: Set the pulleys at chest height and step forward with one foot ahead.
With a slight elbow bend, bring the hands together in front of the chest.
Open slowly until you feel a stretch, keeping the elbow angle fixed.
mistakes: Bending and straightening the elbows like a press
Leaning on the cables with the whole body

name: Dumbbell fly
steps: Lie on a bench with dumbbells over the chest and a soft bend in the elbows.
Lower the arms out wide in an arc until you feel a chest stretch.
Squeeze the chest to bring them back together over the chest.
mistakes: Going too heavy and turning it into a press

name: Close-grip bench press
steps: Grip the bar just inside shoulder width, shoulder blades pinned.
Lower to the lower chest with elbows tucked close to the ribs.
Press up until the elbows lock out.
mistakes: Hands too narrow, straining the wrists

name: Dips
steps: Support yourself on the bars with straight arms and a slight forward lean.
Lower until the upper arms are parallel to the floor.
Press back up to straight arms.
mistakes: Dropping too deep and loading the shoulders

name: Barbell row
steps: Hinge at the hips until the torso is near parallel, back flat.
Pull the bar to the lower ribs, elbows close to the body.
Lower under control without letting the back round.
mistakes: Standing up with every rep to cheat the weight

name: Chest-supported row
steps: Lie chest-down on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Row the dumbbells towards the hips, squeezing the shoulder blades.
Lower to a full stretch without lifting the chest.
mistakes: Shrugging the shoulders up to the ears
Lifting the chest off the pad

name: Dumbbell row
steps: Brace one hand and knee on a bench, back flat.
Pull the dumbbell to the hip, leading with the elbow.
Lower until the arm is straight and the lat is stretched.
mistakes: Twisting the torso to swing the weight
Pulling towards the chest instead of the hip

name: Lat pulldown
steps: Grip the bar just wider than the shoulders and lock the thighs under the pad.
Pull the bar to the upper chest, driving the elbows down.
Return slowly until the arms are fully extended.
mistakes: Pulling the bar behind the neck

name: Pull-ups
steps: Hang from the bar with an overhand grip a little wider than the shoulders.
Pull until the chin clears the bar, driving the elbows down.
Lower to a full hang under control.
mistakes: Stopping short of a full hang

name: Chin-ups
steps: Hang with an underhand grip at shoulder width.
Pull until the chin clears the bar, elbows tight to the sides.
Lower to a full hang.
mistakes: Shrugging instead of pulling with the back

name: Seated cable row
steps: Sit tall with knees soft and the handle at the chest.
Pull the handle to the stomach, squeezing the shoulder blades.
Stretch forward under control without rounding the back.
mistakes: Rocking the torso back and forth

name: Straight-arm pulldown
steps: Stand facing the cable with a slight hip hinge and arms straight.
Sweep the bar down to the thighs, keeping the arms nearly straight.
Return slowly until you feel the lats stretch.
mistakes: Bending the elbows into a pushdown
Using the lower back to swing

name: Face pull
steps: Set a rope at face height and step back with arms extended.
Pull the rope to the face, elbows high and wide.
Squeeze the shoulder blades, then return slowly.
mistakes: Pulling too low towards the chest
Leaning back to move heavy weight

name: Deadlift
steps: Stand with the bar over mid-foot, grip just outside the knees.
Brace, pull the slack out and push the floor away.
Lock out with the hips and knees together, then lower along the legs.
mistakes: Jerking the bar off the floor
Bar drifting away from the legs

name: T-bar row
steps: Straddle the bar with a hip hinge and a flat back.
Pull the handle towards the chest, elbows close.
Lower slowly to a full stretch.
mistakes: Using the hips to heave the weight

name: Machine row
steps: Set the seat so the handles are at chest height and press the chest to the pad.
Pull the handles back, squeezing the shoulder blades.
Return slowly until the arms are straight.
mistakes: Letting the chest come off the pad

name: Overhead press
steps: Grip just outside the shoulders with the bar on the upper chest and squeeze the glutes.
Press straight up, moving the head through as the bar passes.
Lock out over the mid-foot and lower back to the chest.
mistakes: Leaning back and turning it into an incline press
Pressing the bar out in front

name: Dumbbell shoulder press
steps: Sit with the back supported and dumbbells at shoulder height.
Press up until the arms are straight over the shoulders.
Lower to ear height under control.
mistakes: Arching the lower back off the pad
Clanging the dumbbells together at the top

name: Machine shoulder press
steps: Adjust the seat so the handles start at shoulder height.
Press up without locking the elbows.
Lower slowly to the start.

name: Lateral raise
steps: Stand with dumbbells at the sides and a slight elbow bend.
Raise the arms out to shoulder height, leading with the elbows.
Lower slowly without swinging.
mistakes: Swinging the body to lift the weight
Raising the hands above the elbows

name: Cable lateral raise
steps: Stand side-on to a low pulley and grip the handle with the far hand.
Raise the arm out to shoulder height.
Lower slowly, keeping tension on the delt.
mistakes: Leaning away to cheat the weight

name: Rear delt fly
steps: Hinge forward with a flat back and dumbbells hanging down.
Raise the arms out to the sides with a soft elbow bend.
Lower slowly under control.
mistakes: Pinching the shoulder blades instead of leading with the arms

name: Front raise
steps: Stand tall with dumbbells in front of the thighs.
Raise one or both arms to shoulder height.
Lower slowly without swinging.

name: Barbell shrug
steps: Hold the bar in front of the thighs, arms straight.
Lift the shoulders straight up towards the ears.
Pause, then lower slowly.

name: Curl, EZ bar
steps: Grip the angled parts of the bar with elbows by your sides.
Curl up until the forearms are vertical, squeezing the biceps.
Lower slowly to full extension.

name: Biceps curl
steps: Stand tall with dumbbells at your sides, palms forward.
Curl up without moving the elbows.
Lower slowly to a full stretch.
mistakes: Cutting the range short at the bottom

name: Hammer curl
steps: Hold dumbbells with palms facing each other.
Curl up keeping the thumbs pointing up.
Lower slowly with the elbows pinned to the sides.

name: Concentration curl
steps: Sit and rest the elbow against the inner thigh.
Curl the dumbbell towards the shoulder.
Lower slowly to full extension.
mistakes: Leaning back to swing the weight
Lifting the elbow off the thigh

name: Preacher curl
steps: Set the pad so the upper arms lie flat on it.
Curl up without lifting the elbows.
Lower slowly, stopping just short of lockout.
mistakes: Lifting the chest off the pad

name: Cable curl
steps: Stand facing a low pulley with the bar or rope in both hands.
Curl up with the elbows fixed by your sides.
Lower slowly and keep tension on the cable.

name: Triceps pushdown
steps: Stand close to the high pulley, elbows pinned to your sides.
Push the bar or rope down until the arms are straight.
Return until the forearms are just past parallel.
mistakes: Leaning over the bar to push with the body

name: Overhead extension
steps: Face away from a high pulley and hold the rope behind the head.
Extend the arms forward and up until straight.
Return slowly to a deep stretch.

name: Skull crushers
steps: Lie on a bench with an EZ bar held over the chest.
Bend only the elbows to lower the bar towards the forehead.
Extend back up without moving the upper arms.
mistakes: Letting the upper arms drift back

name: Dumbbell kickback
steps: Hinge forward with the upper arm parallel to the floor.
Extend the elbow until the arm is straight.
Return slowly without moving the shoulder.

name: Back squat
steps: Set the bar on the upper back, feet shoulder width, toes slightly out.
Brace and sit down between the hips, knees tracking over the toes.
Drive up through the whole foot to stand tall.
mistakes: Rounding the lower back at the bottom

name: Front squat
steps: Rest the bar on the front delts with elbows high.
Squat down keeping the torso upright.
Stand up, keeping the elbows up the whole way.
mistakes: Elbows dropping so the bar rolls forward

name: Leg press
steps: Sit with the back flat on the pad and feet shoulder width on the platform.
Lower until the knees reach about 90 degrees.
Press up without locking the knees.
mistakes: Lower back rounding off the pad at the bottom
Locking the knees at the top

name: Hack squat
steps: Place the shoulders under the pads, feet shoulder width.
Lower until the thighs are parallel to the platform.
Drive up through the mid-foot.

name: Romanian deadlift
steps: Stand with the bar at the thighs and soft knees.
Push the hips back, sliding the bar down the legs until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Drive the hips forward to stand tall.
mistakes: Bending the knees into a squat

name: Bulgarian split squat
steps: Put the rear foot on a bench and step the front foot forward.
Lower straight down until the front thigh is parallel.
Push through the front heel to stand.
mistakes: Front foot too close to the bench

name: Walking lunge
steps: Hold dumbbells at the sides and take a long step forward.
Lower the back knee towards the floor.
Push through the front foot and step into the next lunge.
mistakes: Short steps that push the knee past the toes

name: Step-up
steps: Place one foot fully on a box about knee height.
Drive through that heel to stand on the box.
Lower slowly with the same leg.

name: Goblet squat
steps: Hold a dumbbell against the chest with elbows pointing down.
Sit down between the knees, chest tall.
Stand up through the whole foot.

name: Leg extension
steps: Adjust the pad to sit just above the ankles.
Extend the knees until the legs are straight.
Lower slowly without letting the stack drop.
mistakes: Lifting the hips off the seat

name: Leg curl
steps: Set the pad just above the heels and the knee in line with the machine pivot.
Curl the heels towards the glutes.
Return slowly to a full stretch.
mistakes: Lifting the hips off the pad

name: Calf raise
steps: Place the balls of the feet on the platform edge.
Rise as high as possible on the toes and pause.
Lower to a deep heel stretch.

name: Hip thrust
steps: Sit with the upper back on a bench and the bar over the hips.
Drive through the heels until the hips are fully extended.
Pause, squeeze the glutes and lower under control.
mistakes: Overarching the lower back at the top
Feet too far from the body

name: Glute bridge
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Lift the hips until the body forms a straight line.
Squeeze at the top and lower slowly.

name: Sumo deadlift
steps: Take a wide stance with toes out and grip inside the knees.
Push the floor apart, keeping the chest up.
Stand tall and lower along the legs.
mistakes: Hips shooting up before the chest

name: Good morning
steps: Place the bar on the upper back with soft knees.
Push the hips back until the torso is near parallel.
Drive the hips forward to stand.

name: Cable kickback
steps: Attach an ankle strap and face the pulley, holding the frame.
Kick the leg back, squeezing the glute.
Return slowly without arching the back.

name: Kettlebell swing
steps: Stand over the kettlebell and hike it back between the legs.
Snap the hips forward to float the bell to chest height.
Let it fall and hinge back for the next rep.

name: Kettlebell goblet squat
steps: Hold the kettlebell by the horns at the chest.
Squat down between the knees, elbows inside the knees.
Stand up, keeping the chest tall.

name: Plank
steps: Rest on the forearms with elbows under the shoulders.
Squeeze glutes and abs so the body is a straight line.
Hold, breathing steadily.

name: Side plank
steps: Lie on one side with the elbow under the shoulder.
Lift the hips so the body is a straight line.
Hold, then switch sides.

name: Crunch
steps: Lie with knees bent and hands by the temples.
Curl the ribs towards the pelvis.
Lower slowly without pulling the neck.

name: Cable crunch
steps: Kneel below a high pulley holding the rope at the head.
Curl the ribs towards the hips, keeping the hips still.
Return slowly.

name: Hanging leg raise
steps: Hang from a bar with a firm grip and the shoulders engaged.
Raise the legs together, curling the pelvis up.
Lower slowly without swinging.
mistakes: Lifting only with the hip flexors

name: Ab wheel rollout
steps: Kneel with the wheel under the shoulders and ribs pulled down.
Roll forward as far as you can keep the back flat.
Pull back using the abs.
mistakes: Rolling out too far too soon

name: Russian twist
steps: Sit leaning back with the knees bent and chest up.
Rotate the torso to each side, moving the hands with the ribs.
Keep the movement slow and controlled.

name: Burpees
steps: From standing, drop the hands to the floor and jump the feet back.
Do a push-up, then jump the feet in.
Jump up with the arms overhead.
